decision: Do not promote source-specific scope graphs as the first contribution or extend repairs on these eight pairs. The current gap is a transferable learning/update algorithm, rather than more per-contract cache examples. Keep the first-contribution focus; do not select a second mechanism yet.
next_research_adjustment: Change the candidate learning object from individual contract caches to a cross-contract reusable acquisition/compiler procedure; require a concrete induction/update algorithm and an independent ordinary program learner before any further real pilot. If no supported algorithm can be specified, report that scientific gap rather than another coverage audit. No extra resource request now.
